title: a16z Podcast: Messages and Movements in Politics AND Business

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In business, as in politics.
reader_summary.overview: In business, as in politics, "the movement is the message" -- whether that "movement" is a product that's taking off grassroots-style in an enterprise. In fact, you can think of political campaigns in general as a lot like startups ... only there's no second place in politics!

key_points.text: In business, as in politics, "the movement is the message" -- whether that "movement" is a product that's taking off grassroots-style in an enterprise.
And you can definitely think of business -- and in particular go-to-market strategy -- as a lot like political campaigns: in allocating marketing resources.
Ultimately, it all comes down to the message -- setting the criteria and narrative as tailored for different "buyer" personas.
